events.title: Henry VII defeats the Yorkist rebels at Stoke Field
events.description: Henry VII crushed a rebel army supporting the pretender Lambert Simnel. It is often counted as the last battle of the Wars of the Roses.
events.html: Henry VII crushed a rebel army supporting the pretender Lambert Simnel. It is often counted as the last battle of the Wars of the Roses.

events.title: Spain declares war on Britain
events.description: Spain joined France in the American War of Independence, aiming to recover Gibraltar and Minorca. The Great Siege of Gibraltar that followed lasted more than three years.
events.html: Spain joined France in the American War of Independence, aiming to recover Gibraltar and Minorca. The Great Siege of Gibraltar that followed lasted more than three years.

events.title: Lincoln delivers his 'House Divided' speech
events.description: Accepting the Illinois Republican nomination for the Senate, Abraham Lincoln warned that the nation could not endure 'permanently half slave and half free'. The speech raised his national profile.
events.html: Accepting the Illinois Republican nomination for the Senate, Abraham Lincoln warned that the nation could not endure 'permanently half slave and half free'. The speech raised his national profile.

events.title: Ford Motor Company is incorporated
events.description: Henry Ford and eleven investors founded the company in Detroit. Its Model T and moving assembly line made cars affordable to millions.
events.html: Henry Ford and eleven investors founded the company in Detroit. Its Model T and moving assembly line made cars affordable to millions.

events.title: Valentina Tereshkova becomes the first woman in space
events.description: Soviet cosmonaut Valentina Tereshkova launched aboard Vostok 6 and orbited Earth 48 times in nearly three days. No other woman flew in space for 19 years.
events.html: Soviet cosmonaut Valentina Tereshkova launched aboard Vostok 6 and orbited Earth 48 times in nearly three days. No other woman flew in space for 19 years.

events.title: Police fire on students in Soweto
events.description: Police shot at schoolchildren marching against compulsory Afrikaans teaching, killing 13-year-old Hector Pieterson among others. The uprising spread, and hundreds died in the months that followed.
events.html: Police shot at schoolchildren marching against compulsory Afrikaans teaching, killing 13-year-old Hector Pieterson among others. The uprising spread, and hundreds died in the months that followed.
